about: From the University of Adelaide's «Database of Regional, National and Global Winegrape Bearing Areas by Variety, 2000 to 2023» (K. Anderson, S. Nelgen and G. Puga, Wine Economics Research Centre, December 2025, revised March 2026; CC BY 4.0). Changed: rows summed by region and by library grape; a region's grapes are those covering at least 2 % of its bearing area, the twelve largest; South Africa's statistical regions give grapes only; origins left out where disputed. Built by scripts/kb/read-adelaide.ts.
